name: Library Escape
storyline: A mysterious haunted library appears out of nowhere. A curious girl enters it to investigate, only to find herself trapped inside. To escape, she must reach the CORE Book and destroy the library from within.
summary:
Library Escape is a 2D platformer set in a mysterious haunted library that appeared out of nowhere. A curious girl enters it to investigate, only to find herself trapped in a series of dangerous rooms filled with unique enemies.

Fight your way through each challenge and reach the CORE Book — the heart of the library — to destroy it from within and escape.
